title: Guys, where do I find cool/juice battle/attack animations for an action rpg game?
author: Ha_Ha_Hell

comments.author: Josh-Wood88
comments.body: Mixamo is a good starting point if u're working in 3D are u looking for realistic combat animations or more flashy stylized ones?

replies.author: Ha_Ha_Hell
replies.body:
I'm building a 3D action rpg. Losely inspired on Kingdom Hearts look and feel.  
So, more cartoonish characters and wide overreacting movements.

I'm aware of Mixamo, but couldn't find the "spark" I'm looking there.

comments.author: kkostenkov
comments.body: Please provide more context. Types of characters/setting. 2D, 3D, sprite flip book animations? What type of rig do you use? Or you are looking for video references?

replies.author: Ordinary-Willow4866
replies.body: im looking VFX for 2D and 3D for a TCG game, where can i find? Unity

replies.author: kkostenkov
replies.body:
Try searching itch.io
It has plenty of free and paid assets that could be tailored to a decent game. GitHub sometimes. 
Engine does not matter here imo
